name: Nacho Sánchez Amor - Projet de décision du Conseil
title: RECOMMENDATION on the draft Council decision on the conclusion of the Enhanced Partnership and Cooperation Agreement between the European Union and its Member States, of the one part, and the Kyrgyz Republic, of the other part
part_text:
The European Parliament has agreed to a new partnership agreement between the European Union and Kyrgyzstan. This is a formal deal covering cooperation between the two sides. Parliament's role here was simply to give or refuse its consent, and it gave consent. The agreement can now move forward. The report does not describe what the agreement contains in detail, so it does not list specific changes to rules or rights.

- The European Union and Kyrgyzstan get a new cooperation agreement, now approved by Parliament.
- It affects the governments and people of the European Union's member states and Kyrgyzstan.
- Next, the agreement is formally concluded and can enter into force.
